text:
Imagine everyone locks.

Every trade on a memecoin pays a fee. On most launchpads none of it reaches the people holding the coin.

On IMAGINE, it goes to the holders who lock — paid in whatever the coin is paired with.

imagine.fun

Lock the meme. Earn its pair.

IMAGINE coins launch on StonkFun, where every coin is paired with an asset: an xStock like NVDAx or SPYx, a stablecoin, or SOL.

A coin paired with NVDAx pays its lockers NVDAx. A SOL-paired coin pays SOL.

Two streams, both in the coin's pair asset:

— 1% of each trade routed through imagine.fun, paid into the coin's pool in the same tx
— the creator share StonkFun forwards to the coin's creator address: its pool vault

90% streams to lockers by weight. 10% to treasury.

Your weight is your amount times your term, on a square-root curve so short locks still count:

4h → 1.00×
1d → 1.14×
7d → 1.41×
30d → 1.86×
90d → 2.49×
180d → 3.11×
365d → 4.00×

Lock 0.1% of supply or more and a size tier adds up to 50% on top.

Claiming never touches your lock. Your lock never blocks a claim.

Fees stream in over an hour instead of landing at once, so a share is earned by holding through time, not by showing up at the right second.

Selling is free. It just costs you the stream.

Break a lock early and your unclaimed rewards go back to the people who stayed, and a slice of your principal is burned, scaled by how much of your term is left.

What the program cannot do:

— no admin withdraw path. No instruction moves a pool's funds to an admin
— terms are frozen on each pool at launch
— claims and unlocks cannot be paused
— the creator locks first, in the launch transaction

Launching takes one transaction: the coin is created on StonkFun, the dev buy lands, and the creator's founding lock opens — together.

The coin trades on StonkFun's curve and shows up where StonkFun coins do.
No wallet? Sign in with Google and get a Solana address held for you. Lock, claim, withdraw or export the key whenever you want.

The honest part: a coin nobody trades pays nothing, and a locked bag can't be sold for free into a decline. Every rate on the site is trailing, realised fees. Nothing is projected.

Source, tests and the security review: imagine.fun/docs/security
